notes.title: Training System Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

The release earlier this month updated the Training system to switch up the gameplay a little!  The initial visible attributes are now mixed between the A and B options so that neither option begins fully revealed, meaning that you never have a complete option to pick initially.  This increases the importance of using your training points wisely as there’ll no longer be a fully revealed option you can ‘safely’ fall back on.

We also tweaked the potential career paths of players by increasing the variance of training options throughout their careers, especially for older players.  This means that there is potentially a lot more scope for some older players to retain their useability if the right options come along for them - again, meaning that using those training points wisely will become even more important.

notes.notes:
Hi everyone

Yesterday there was the first of a series of updates focussing on improving the match experience.  The tactics interface along with the squad page have been completely overhauled.  Included as part of the overhaul was the new tactical instructions to assign set piece taker/roles.

90 Minute Fever also exited Steam Early Access yesterday.  We just wanted to say a big thank you to all of you who have been with us through the Early Access journey. It has certainly taken us a lot longer than we first envisioned, and taken more than a few iterations of league, fixture, transfer and other systems. But we have finally got to the stage where the core gameplay mechanics are balanced, engaging, fair, fun and without fundamental flaws. The barrier to entry for new users is no longer unreasonably high. The game rewards skillful gameplay and has an extremely high skill ceiling. We believe the game is a fantastic option compared to all the other online football management games out there. Thank you for your feedback, both positive and negative, it has been invaluable and continues to be so.

There is a lot more we wish to add to the game. We are currently working on a club records area, competition records, revamping the rankings, access to additional match stats including a wide array of live player stats during matches, further enhancing the new set pieces functionality to include the ability to change the assignments during matches, as well as a match engine logic update. 

What can I do to help? We’d love some help in three areas:
[olist]
    We are likely to have many new users asking questions on Discord. Any friendly help and advice you are able to provide would make a real difference to their initial experience of the game.
    Help us rank higher on the magical Steam algorithm! Spread the word! We’ll be regularly posting on social media (Facebook, Twitter) going forwards so if you share/like/retweet/etc our posts that would really help.
    If anyone has the time and willingness to help with translation of the game into more languages that would be hugely appreciated.  Currently the game is fully playable in English, Greek and Brazilian Portuguese, but we would love to make the game more accessible to people who speak other languages.  Having additional languages can help a lot, we’ve seen a real surge of new user signups from Brazil and Portugal in recent months. If you are able to help in this area, please look in the translations area of the official Discord server. We’re looking to make this process a little easier than it has been to date, and we’ll be posting updated information on this in the next couple days.  
[/olist]

Thank you again for being with us on our epic journey.  Good luck for the seasons ahead!

notes.title: Major Update - Added Cups, Player Search, New Training System, Reset
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

There has been a major update at the start of this month including a gamewide reset.  This is a major update that touches pretty much all areas of the game but some of the headline changes include:

The transfer system has seen a complete overhaul.  Players will now undergo an auction process when they enter the transfer market.  After which if nobody bids for them they will be instantly purchasable by anyone in the game.  A player search feature has been added to help you scour over the many, many thousands of players that will now be available to you to find and buy!  

The league system has also seen a complete overhaul.  Clubs are now split into 16 team leagues with the top 4 getting promoted and the bottom 4 getting relegated each season.

Cups have also been added to the game.  The top 4 in each of the top division leagues now qualify for the Sans Pareil Cup (a cup with a group phase and then KO rounds) the following season, the winner of which will be crowned top dog.  There are also a variety of other cups being added, including a Youth Cup (for the very best youth teams), League Cups (one for each league), and a Cup Holders’ Cup (for the winners of each of the League Cups).

The Training System has been improved.  Players will now each earn Development Points when playing matches.  These points can be spent to reveal attributes on the “B” training options, to add/change positions of players, and to hasten their recovery from injury.

As we are at the tail end of the Early Access cycle now, a full reset of the game has happened in preparation for the leadup to the official game launch.

notes.title: 90MF Development Update - What’s on the Horizon?
notes.notes:
Hi guys

Just a quick update with an overview of what we are working on at the moment and when to expect it in the game.

The next update will be, by far, the biggest one we have ever done!  Amongst other things it will include:
   A complete overhaul of the game interface with a completely new UI to make it look much more modern and aesthetically pleasing, as well as being inline with current UI design best practises and more intuitive to use
   Visualisation of the match experience using retro style pixel-art graphics, inspired by old-school games like Sensible Soccer and Kick Off
   Shifting the monetisation focus to be more based on customisation and cosmetics and less based on impacting gameplay
   More data-related content (stats, history, leaderboards, records, etc)
   A new training feature giving you far more influence over how your players’ attributes develop
   Changes to the transfer system and academy trials system to make them more engaging, competitive, challenging and exciting
   Club progression will be far better rewarded: higher standing within the pyramid league structure will yield significantly more benefits than it does at present
   Major update/improvements to the match engine including more tactical options
   More manager skills
   More things to do on a daily basis as part of the core gameplay loop
   Drastically improving the new user experience
   Significant improvements to the performance and responsiveness of the client when navigating around screens and data
   Various quality of life features

We have decided to release all of this in one 'big' update rather than in several smaller updates for two main reasons:
   From a development point of view this allows us to focus our time on getting more done rather than having to focus on building and testing numerous versions of the game
   We want to create the new additions and changes straight into the new game interface we are working on, rather than doing it twice.  Note: this is the reason why various data-related content such as stats and history has not been implemented yet

Our best estimate at the moment is that this major update will happen at the end of August.  In an ideal world we would have had this update ready much sooner than this.  Unfortunately we are not living in an ideal world at the moment and the global pandemic this past year has had a very significant impact on this project and those involved in it.

We hope you are looking forward to these changes as much as we are!  Thank you for taking the time to read.  We will be posting monthly updates with various additional information and details about the upcoming release!

notes.title: Update v0.12.0 - Welcome to the Pyramid
notes.notes:
Some important changes have been made to the game that should provide some exciting new challenges for managers to get their teeth into! 

The game is now far more flexible and accessible, and allows managers to play at their own convenience (no waiting around all the time anymore).  Competitions now revolve around ensuring clubs are competing against other clubs that are at similar levels.

The game is also now a lot more competitive and relegation is now a real possibility each and every season - even for the very best clubs in the game.

Better performance is now much better rewarded and there is a much higher ceiling that can be reached by the very best teams in the game.

For more information please read:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/468070/discussions/1/2837788120355650224/

notes.title: Update v0.11.0 - Manager Skills
notes.notes:
Manager Skills are now in 90MF!  They add a lot of real skill and tough decisions to the game, and will ensure that you can never rest on your laurels - they will press you to deliver the goods for your club each and every season and directly reward you for doing so!

As well as better get on the end of aerial balls that are fast moving to attempt headers)

- Improved overall ability of players to interact with the ball, especially if fast moving and/or off the ground.  This will have various knock-on impacts such as ability of keepers saving shots, defenders blocking shots, players winning headers, etc
- Overhauled much of the goalkeeper shot stopping AI.  Goalkeepers are now capable of delivering much stronger performances

(1 in Teamwork means each of that player's attributes is reduced by 1.  20 in Teamwork means no attribute reduction at all and player plays just as well away from home than they do at home.  2-19 in Teamwork scales between 1 and 0 attribute reduction)
     Added player attribute Flair (outfield players only): A player's ability to do unexpected things and draw fouls from opposition players whilst they are dribbling the ball.
     Anticipation (GK's only) attribute added.  How well a goalkeeper can anticipate through balls and 'rush out' to claim the ball for themselves.
     Composure (GK's only) attribute added (Composure is no longer tied to Technique for Keepers).  The ability of a goalkeeper to catch the ball as opposed to just deflect it when unexpected things happen (such as the ball taking a deflection off another player or hitting the woodwork).
     Attributes that reduce other attributes are no longer subject to reductions for any reason (i.e. condition loss, playing out of position, playing away).  These attributes are: Teamwork, Endurance, Natural Fitness, Injury Proneness.  This is to prevent attribute losses 'compounding' on each other.

     Corner taking ability of players rebalanced (good players are now better, bad players are unchanged) i.e. players who are good at taking corners are now better at taking corners than they were before
     First Touch (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are now much better, bad players are now much better) i.e. all players are now much better when taking their first touch to control the ball
     Jumping/Strength (outfielders) attributes rebalanced (good players are now a little better, bad players are now a little worse) i.e. these attributes are now a little more important generally to be able to win headers
     Marking attribute rebalanced (good players are unchanged, bad players are now worse) i.e. players with low marking are now worse at marking opponents
     Vision (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are now much better, bad players are now a little better) i.e. better ability to see openings for potential passes across the board, but especially for players that are high in Vision
     Crossing attribute rebalanced (good players are now much better, bad players are now a little better) i.e. better quality of crossing across the board, but especially for players that are high in Crossing
     Reading of Game (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players now a little better, bad players are now a little worse) i.e. this attribute is now more important across the board
     Off the Ball (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players now a little better, bad players are now a little worse) i.e. this attribute is now more important across the board
     Finishing & Long Shots (outfielders) attributes rebalanced (good players are now a little better at shooting in normal play, bad players are now a little better at shooting in normal play) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board
     Composure (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are now better at performing in critical defensive situations, bad players are now better at performing in critical defensive situations) i.e. this attribute is now more important (defensively) across the board
     Tenacity (outfielders) attribute rebalanced (good players are unchanged, bad players are now a little better) i.e. players with low tenacity are now a little more likely to get stuck in to attempt to make tackles 
     Technique (GK's) attribute rebalanced (good players are unchanged, bad players are now better) i.e. bad technique keepers are now better to parrying shots
     Reflexes (GK's) attribute rebalanced (good players are now better, bad players are now better) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board
     Agility/Balance (GK's) attributes rebalanced (good players are now better, bad players are now better) i.e. these attributes are now more important across the board

     Balancing changes to player match rating/10 system
     Fixed full time whistle not blowing at full time if there was a penalty shootout to follow
     Various stability improvements/fixes

* Please note regarding all the above attribute balancing changes:  Only those tagged as 'much better/worse' are likely to be noticeable to the human eye (and only to the very observant).  The rest, especially those tagged as 'little better/worse' are almost certainly not noticeable to the human eye and only apparent in a meaningful way when analysing large volumes of match results.

notes.title: Update 0.3.2
notes.notes:
August Update


New Features and Changes:
     There is now a 64 bit version of the game client for Windows on Steam.  Should improve performance on 64 bit operating systems and fix some OS level bugs that some users were facing associated with this
     Cup Matches and Friendly Matches can no longer result in a draw and will now go to extra time and penalty shootouts
     Injured and Suspended players can now play in Super Friendly League matches
     Added new Notification Settings widget to the Settings layout
     Added ‘Friendly Invitation’ event to sound settings
     Complete overhaul of Customise UI load/save/share interface and codebase.  Note: it’s still a WIP and there’s still issues with sharing layouts with other users
     Complete revamp of the default layout
     Now able to customise Squad List, Lineup List and Match Lineup List for Senior and Youth squads
     Clear and Autoselect buttons are now right aligned on Squad layout views
     Improved visual appearance, usability and responsiveness of the Uniform creator widget on the Customise layout
     Improved scaling/rescaling on Trophy Cabinet widget
     Trophy Room widget now displays text that no trophies have been won if no trophies have been won
     Improved rendering quality of logos
     Club Logo widget added to Club Profile Layout
     Online User-List widget added to Calendar Layout
     Sorting by the League column on FA Layouts will now sort by 1,2,3,4,5,etc rather than 1,10,2,3,4,5,etc
     Added right club drop list functionality when right clicking on Club names on results widget on Competition pages (previously only worked on the fixtures widget)
     Improved scaling of reputation stars column
     Improved increment value ranges on drop list for when bidding for Staff
     Improved account registration error pop-up message content/information
     Added many more flags for nationalities into the game client

Chat and Mail Message Changes and Fixes:
     Added Chat Agreement that user must accept in order to use the chat functionality in the game
     Added command to chat channels ‘/clear’ which will clear all text in the chat channel for the user (and will also fix any bugs caused for that user by broken hyperlinks)
     Added profanity filter to the game client
     Character Map Accents now supported (both 3 digit and 4 digit) i.e. (Alt + ???%)
     Now when a user has a ban from public chat they also cannot submit feedback
     Mail Messaging System is improved and optimised for better performance
     Hyperlink functionality added to mail messaging system
     Fixed bug where player names and links to player profiles not appearing in mail message notifications

Match Experience Changes and Fixes:
     Drastic improvements to stability of matches, many reasons why matches can crash have been fixed
     Drastic improvements to match synchronisation and match UI performance (particularly with Pitch and Team Sheet overlays), making changes should be far more responsive now and many bugs associated with this have now been fixed
     Added individual player stats viewable on hover during matches (for Total Shots, Shots on Target, Chances Created, Key Defensive Plays, Assists, Fouls)
     Major commentary engine update
     More match sounds added
     Vuvuzela match ambiance option added
     Able to assign Penalty taker in tactics (draggable ‘P’ icon)
     Added extra time for cup matches (and friendly matches)
     Added penalty shootouts
     New match overlay for Penalty Shootouts
     Ability to order penalty shootout takers before penalty shootout commences
     New match event type of ‘Warnings’ (ticked-off by referee) with associated icon (white card with X mark inside)
     New rules for user personal pause clock timers.  120 seconds at start of match, 60 seconds added at half time, 60 seconds added at full time if the match will go to extra time

notes.title: End of August Release Update
notes.notes:
The end of August release has not happened yet.  We've been working very long hours this entire month hoping we could make it happen, but unfortunately we've fallen a little short.


Billing Issues
The main (well, pretty much only) reason there is a delay is due to the billing issues we have been having with Steam.  These have resulted in a huge amount of work for us.  Both in regards to manually resolving 100's of individual user cases as well as trying to come up with permanent solutions going forwards.  A lot of progress has been made on this front and we expect that we'll have this situation under control before the end of this month.  Unfortunately this issue could not have been foreseen by us - and the scale of the amount of work involved here for us has been truly epic.

We have been doing our absolute best to try get in the End of August update on time but we've not quite been able to pull it off.  Whilst it is very important for us that we deliver updates on time, it is more important to us that we deliver updates with the correct amount of quality and testing.  

There are some known issues with the current release and we're still working on resolving these, but most of the current release is of a good enough standard to be deployed into Beta and this will happen tomorrow late afternoon.  


Beta Access 
Anyone who is a paying user is able to request access to Beta.  To request this access please fill out this form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1pViDzwDeAhrpWYYw5PKUbuGrPD-hnnuCEnEw382tqAnkzA/viewform

If you do so you'll be granted Beta access within 24 hours of doing so.  This will add another 90MF client application for Beta into your Steam library.  Existing beta users are able to fill out this request as well.  It will be possible to have both 90MF Clients (for Live and Beta) open at the same time.

The full release will go into live at some point next week.  Exactly when will largely be determined by the issues users find with the release in Beta.


Major Match Engine Update #1
The Major Match Engine Update #1 scheduled for release into Live at the end of this month is in quite an advanced state and it will be deployed into Beta during this month.


Road Map Updated
We've updated the Road Map to hopefully put ourselves back into position to deliver what we are saying we are going to deliver when we are saying we are going to deliver it.  The updated Roam Map can be found here:
http://90minutefever.com/roadmap/

There has been some guesswork involved here (obviously).  Unfortunately for us, the Billing Issues, whilst we're 'on top' of them, they are very far from resolved.  We still have a lot of work to do here, and there have been a lot of assumptions been made by both Steam and ourselves about how their systems work, hopefully these are all correct, but it has definitely been the case in the past that similar such assumptions about how their systems work have been incorrect.  So here's to hoping!

Changes to the road map are the delay of Player Comparison Tool and Chat Enhancements from End of September to October release.  New Pre-Match Screen from End of October to November.  Also we've added Core Staff System to the End of November release.


Our Apologies
Our sincere apologies here and we can assure you we've been doing our absolute best to deal with the billing issues whilst trying to keep all the rest of the development on track.

We'll continue to do our best to stay on top of things, from our perspective the billing issues (ever since launch), have been nothing short of an absolute nightmare.  We'll be extremely glad when we're able to see the back of them.
